Lemma
[Fisher and entropy dissipation] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0048, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0049 ↗ def:chow-iv-weighted-operators 1. ch27:eq-27.119–27.127\group Logarithmic Sobolev inequality

For $\square _f\xi =| abla \xi |^2$ and normalized $\int e^{\xi -f}=(4\pi )^{n/2}$, define $I(\xi )=\int | abla \xi |^2e^{\xi -f}$ and $H(\xi )=\int \xi e^{\xi -f}$. Then \[ I'(t)=-\int e^{\xi }(2| abla ^2\xi |^2+| abla \xi |^2)e^{-f}\le -I(t), \qquad H'(t)=-I(t), \] and hence $H(\xi )\le I(\xi )$, yielding the sharp inequality above.
